# Translator

> Agent-operated translated captions and bounded PC audio sharing.

Start with `uv run --locked translator agent search --query "your goal"`.
Check retrieval status, then read the candidate's exact definition, prerequisites and input sources.
Ambiguous, unsupported or unmatched retrieval is not permission to guess an operation.
Search is local BM25/CJK retrieval; it does not execute, call an LLM, or create a profile.
Use `catalog --command NAME` for a known operation; request full `catalog` only if needed.
Use an explicit data directory. Read `ok` before continuing. Session IDs come from results.
